rationale: The stock gapped down ~5.4% with no news catalyst, then recovered sharply intraday (now at 74.8% of today's range, well above VWAP at $26.44 and 9-EMA at $26.29), suggesting a potential short-squeeze or mean-reversion move already largely played out. The bid-ask spread of 136 bps is extremely wide relative to the ATR, making entry cost prohibitive and risk/reward unfavorable in either direction. With price already extended above VWAP and no clear structural level to anchor a stop without excessive risk, the setup lacks sufficient edge to justify a position.
